_about: Duties the Whiterun Guard hands its members, read by guard/duty.py. Edit freely. A member's superior (the lowest-ranked leader above them in orgs.json) gives one duty at a time when the member comes to them: only duties whose hours include the current hour, whose rank range fits (min_rank..max_rank, null = no limit) and that differ from the member's last duty. A shift lasts shift_hours from when it is given. The member counts as at their post when a conversation happens at a location whose name contains one of 'where' during the shift (the game reports the location with every conversation). Reporting back before half the shift has passed counts as leaving early. A report with no sign of the member at their post is a false report. merit is what an honest, completed duty adds to the service record (a missed one costs missed_merit, a false report false_merit).

duties.title: stand watch at the main gate
duties.why: Every traveller, caravan and drunk from the Bannered Mare's road comes through the main gate, and the Jarl wants eyes on all of them
duties.instructions: Stand by the main gate, question strangers who look like trouble, and keep the road clear.

duties.title: walk the walls and the Plains District on patrol
duties.why: Giants, bandits and now dragons come from the plains, and the walls are only as good as the guards on them
duties.instructions: Walk the wall walks and the Plains District, look out over the plains, and report anything odd.

duties.title: keep order in the Plains District market
duties.why: Pickpockets work the market stalls and tempers run hot over prices
duties.instructions: Stay near the market stalls, watch for thieves, and calm quarrels before they turn into fights.

duties.title: drill with the other recruits at the barracks
duties.why: A recruit who cannot hold a shield wall is a danger to the guard beside them
duties.instructions: Go to the barracks by the main gate and drill: shield, sword and bow.

duties.title: walk the evening lamp round with the watch
duties.why: When the sun goes down the braziers on the walls and the gate need lighting and tending, and a recruit learns the night streets that way
duties.instructions: Go round with the evening watch: light and tend the braziers on the walls and at the gate, and walk the Plains District until the streets are quiet.

duties.title: keep the night watch on the walls
duties.why: Most trouble comes after dark, and the night watch is the one nobody wants
duties.instructions: Take the night watch on the walls and at the gate until the morning shift relieves you.

duties.title: stand guard in Dragonsreach
duties.why: The Jarl holds court in Dragonsreach, and petitioners, envoys and the odd madman come before him every day
duties.instructions: Stand your post in the great hall of Dragonsreach and keep the peace before the Jarl's throne.
